dedupe_keys.name: awaken wind farm wake benchmark inputs

description: The AWAKEN team publishes the inputs distributed during the IEA Wind Task 57 wind-farm wake benchmark. The June 2025 deposit provides three ZIP packages under CC BY 4.0, one for each benchmark phase. The exercise ran in 2024–2025 around a case selected for 24 August 2023. Public documentation distinguishes an initial limited-input simulation, a second phase adding inflow observations and a third adding wake observations. These inputs can reproduce the staged information available to participants and compare wind-farm atmosphere simulations. They are freely downloadable, but the public inventory does not establish every internal format, sampling rate or geographic coordinate. No related catalogue parent explicitly covers these benchmark packages. The wider AWAKEN field campaign is their observational source, not evidence that every measurement is included. Archive contents and model-performance claims were not independently checked.
